messages:
Morgan Liu: Heads-up: we'll migrate from static deploy keys to Vault-issued SSH certs next Tue 2026-04-07 01:00-02:00 UTC. Primary aim: eliminate leaked long-lived keys and centralize auditing. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ssh-cert-migration.

Priya Nair: Do self-hosted runners need changes?

Evan Chen: Yes — runners will use the vault-agent to request short-lived certs. We added a small GH Actions step and a runner systemd unit that refreshes certs every 25m. Template in infra-templates repo.

Julian Ortiz: What about service accounts currently using SSH keys for deployments?

Evan Chen: Please file a ticket with service name and current key path. We can whitelist an automated mint role for a short window or help migrate to the cert flow.

infra-bot: Notice: old deploy keys scheduled for revocation: 2026-04-07 02:00:00 UTC. Backups will remain for 7 days read-only.

Morgan Liu: Quick checklist for teams: 1) Try local cert mint (see runbook); 2) Update CI templates if you run self-hosted runners; 3) If you can't migrate, submit an exception request by EOD Mon.

Priya Nair: I'll coordinate with Platform to roll the change across prod runners. Tagging @Evan Chen to confirm template PR timeline.

Evan Chen: PRs open by Fri. I'll host an office hours session Mon 16:00 UTC in #eng-infra for walkthroughs.

deploy-bot: [deploy] infra-templates:gha-step added 1792414000

Morgan Liu: Thanks all. Reply 'verified' once you've tested the mint and a push to a test repo. If you hit blockers, DM me or ping #eng-oncall.
